title: Writing Test
description: The separate TOEIC Writing test: 8 questions in about 60 minutes, scored 0–200, plus a Speaking & Writing practice test.

id.title: Tes Writing
id.description: Tes TOEIC Writing yang terpisah: 8 soal dalam sekitar 60 menit, dinilai 0–200, plus latihan tes Speaking & Writing.

nodes.title: Write a Sentence Based on a Picture
nodes.summary: Questions 1–5: write one sentence about a picture using two given words (8 minutes for all five).

objectives.text: Write one grammatical sentence that uses both given words, changing their form if needed
Make the sentence describe what is actually in the picture
Check each sentence for agreement, articles and punctuation within the time limit

id.title: Write a Sentence Based on a Picture
id.summary: Soal 1–5: menulis satu kalimat tentang gambar dengan memakai dua kata yang diberikan (8 menit untuk kelima soal).

objectives.use-both-words: Menulis satu kalimat yang benar secara grammar dengan memakai kedua kata yang diberikan, mengubah bentuknya bila perlu
objectives.relevant-to-picture: Membuat kalimat yang sesuai dengan isi gambar
objectives.check-quickly: Memeriksa setiap kalimat (kesesuaian subjek-kata kerja, artikel dan tanda baca) dalam batas waktu

nodes.title: Respond to a Written Request
nodes.summary: Questions 6–7: read an e-mail and write a reply that completes the listed tasks (10 minutes each).

objectives.text: Complete every task the directions list (e.g. ask two questions and make one request)
Use a clear e-mail structure: greeting, purpose, details and closing
Use a polite, professional tone and varied sentences

id.title: Respond to a Written Request
id.summary: Soal 6–7: membaca e-mail dan menulis balasan yang menyelesaikan tugas-tugas yang diminta (10 menit per soal).

objectives.cover-all-tasks: Menyelesaikan semua tugas yang diminta petunjuk (mis. mengajukan dua pertanyaan dan satu permintaan)
objectives.email-structure: Memakai struktur e-mail yang jelas: salam, tujuan, detail dan penutup
objectives.polite-tone: Memakai nada sopan dan profesional serta variasi kalimat

nodes.title: Write an Opinion Essay
nodes.summary: Question 8: plan, write and revise an opinion essay in 30 minutes (ETS suggests at least 300 words).

objectives.text: Plan an essay in under five minutes: position, two or three reasons, examples
Write an introduction, body paragraphs with support and a conclusion
Leave time to revise grammar, word choice and connectors

id.title: Write an Opinion Essay
id.summary: Soal 8: merencanakan, menulis dan merevisi esai opini dalam 30 menit (ETS menyarankan minimal 300 kata).

objectives.essay-plan: Merencanakan esai dalam kurang dari lima menit: pendapat, dua atau tiga alasan, contoh
objectives.paragraphs: Menulis pendahuluan, paragraf isi dengan dukungan, dan kesimpulan
objectives.revise: Menyisakan waktu untuk merevisi grammar, pilihan kata dan kata penghubung

nodes.title: Speaking & Writing Practice Test
nodes.summary: Full timed Speaking and Writing practice with feedback based on the official evaluation criteria.

objectives.text: Complete all 11 Speaking tasks with the real preparation and response times
Complete all 8 Writing tasks within about 60 minutes
Review your answers against the official criteria (pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, organisation, relevance) and pick one focus per test

id.title: Latihan Tes Speaking & Writing
id.summary: Latihan Speaking dan Writing lengkap dengan waktu, plus umpan balik berdasarkan kriteria penilaian resmi.

objectives.timed-speaking: Menyelesaikan 11 tugas Speaking dengan waktu persiapan dan menjawab seperti aslinya
objectives.timed-writing: Menyelesaikan 8 tugas Writing dalam sekitar 60 menit
objectives.criteria-review: Meninjau jawabanmu dengan kriteria resmi (pelafalan, grammar, kosakata, organisasi, relevansi) dan memilih satu fokus per tes
